work_items.title: Deliver bounded-memory stochastic RNA velocity
work_items.objective: Implement second-order neighborhood moments, residual-scale estimation, stable joint weighted fitting, explicit deterministic fallback and deep customization using anndata.cppm, with independent numerical and memory qualification.
work_items.outcome: Native consumers can run and customize a streaming stochastic estimator with an independent reference and qualified numerical, memory, runtime and module-build evidence.

assertions: Raw second moments coalesce expression duplicates before products, support existing dense/CSR/CSC acquisition contracts, and allocate no full source-product matrices.
Stochastic refinement uses the declared scVelo GLS equations, consistent fit-row masks, explicit selection policies and finite deterministic fallbacks with distinct statuses.
Custom moments, scales, fitting and whole-block execution can replace reference stages; explicit compiled reference execution remains independent.

Independent ordinary-case moments meet atol 1e-6 rtol 1e-5; slopes/scales meet atol 1e-5 rtol 1e-4; residuals and intercepts use gene-scaled atol 1e-5 rtol 1e-4; normalized objectives agree within 1e-4.

Three paired canonical bounded measurements establish at least 10x lower preparation-inclusive incremental peak memory and no median end-to-end runtime regression versus the matched scVelo stochastic baseline.
Native, Release, shared, sanitizer, installed consumers and Milestone 1 regressions pass; isolated module rebuild probe preserves public BMIs and consumer objects after a private edit.
GPU, Bayesian/dynamical fitting, velocity graphs, backed orchestration and Python runtime bindings remain outside this milestone.

requirements.description: Run native stochastic, deterministic regression, examples and installed consumer tests.
